newsitem.title: USA: Home Bancorp of Elgin offer raises $70 mln.
newsitem.headline: Home Bancorp of Elgin offer raises $70 mln.

text.p: Home Bancorp of Elgin Inc said Thursday it completed a public offering of 7,009,250 shares at a subscription offering price of $10 per share, raising $70 million in gross proceeds.
The company, formerly a mutual savings and loan, converted to a federally chartered stock savings and loan association. Its conversion plan won Office of Thrift Supervision approval on July 25.
The entire offering was fully subscribed for by the association's depositors and Home Bancorp's employee stock ownership plan.
Trading in the $300.4 million asset company's common stock is scheduled to start September 27 under the symbol "HBEI."
